results.title: Building on Abacum Intelligence, Abacum Launches Modeler and Brings Agentic Modeling to Every Finance Team
results.content:
Abacum is the AI-native business planning platform. Built first for finance and extended to every department, Abacum holds a company's data, business logic and context in one governed layer, where AI agents and teams plan the business together. Agents own the recurring workflows; people own the judgment. More than 500 customers in over 40 countries run their planning on Abacum, including DISH, ThoughtSpot, Strava, Acorns and Replit. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York, with offices in [...] with offices in Toronto, Barcelona, Buenos Aires and the UK, Abacum is backed by more than $100 million from investors including Scale Venture Partners, Atomico and Y Combinator. Abacum is ISO/IEC 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, and is the first new FP&A platform NetSuite has accepted into its Built for NetSuite program in over a decade. Learn more at [...] Time back for the work that matters

With Modeler, the hours that used to go into building go into using the model. A headcount plan the VP of Finance needs by Friday is ready the same morning. A new revenue model for the board starts as a request, not a blank canvas. A question about how a forecast is calculated gets answered on the spot, without waiting for the one person who built it. Finance teams move faster, and the expertise stays with the team.
